measures.title: Household Energy Payment: £100 council tax rebate for bands A-D from January 2027
Support for Energy Bills: Cut VAT on domestic electricity from 5% to 0% from 1 October 2026 to 1 July 2027
Fuel Duty: Extend the temporary 5p-per-litre duty cut and defer the planned Retail Prices Index (RPI) increase to 1 July 2027
Bus Fares: Cap single bus fares at £2 in England outside London for one year from 1 January 2027, funded by reprioritising DESNZ budgets
Mileage Rates: Increase the tax-free and tax-deductible car and van rates to 55p for the first 10,000 business miles from 6 April 2026 and the higher mileage rate to 35p from 6 April 2027
Parental Pay: Establish a Parental Allowance for fathers, partners and adopters in Great Britain from April 2029
Carer’s Allowance: Introduce a taper on earnings above the Weekly Earning Limit within 2030-31
Universal Credit: Extend the £2,500 surplus earnings threshold for one year from 1 April 2027
Early Years: Fund increased access to books for children aged 0 to 5

Tariff Suspension Packages: Suspend tariffs on 135 food products from 21 June 2026 until 31 December 2028; 101 food products and kerosene for heating oil from 26 November 2026 until 31 December 2028; and fertiliser from 26 November 2026 until 31 December 2027
Cash ISAs: Maintain the cash ISA limit at £20,000 from 6 April 2027
Business Rates: Increase business rates relief for pubs, social clubs and live music venues by 20ppts to 35% from 1 April 2027

Business Rates: Increase valuation thresholds for Small Business Rate Relief for retail, hospitality and leisure (RHL) properties from £12,000 to £18,000 for 100% relief and from £15,000 to £21,000 for tapered relief from 1 April 2027

Business Rates: Introduce a transitional support package, including a two-year real terms bills freeze for RHL businesses and a one-year extension of the 2023 Supporting Small Business support, part funded by extending the Transitional Relief Supplement for two years from 1 April 2027
Trading Allowance: Increase the Income Tax Trading Allowance to £3,000 from £1,000 from 6 April 2027
Business Tariff Suspensions: Suspend tariffs on 72 products from 5 August 2026 and extend suspensions for 361 products in 2027-28
Climate Change Levy: Freeze electricity & liquefied petroleum gas main rates, and uprate gas and solid fuels main rates by RPI from 1 April 2028
Red Diesel: Reduce duty rates by 3.7p-per-litre from 15 June 2026 to 1 July 2027
Alcohol Duty: Increase the generosity of Small Producer Relief from 1 February 2027
Good Growth Funds: Seed funding for Mayors and local leaders in England and £1.5bn finance for Mayoral Strategic Authorities with a mechanism for subsidised lending (resource impacts of subsidy)
Business Rates Retention: Devolve a share of business rates income and growth to Mayoral Strategic Authorities from April 2027
Youth Employment and Skills: Expand local apprenticeship services to all current mayors
Regional Growth: Fund priority investments and local growth & regeneration projects across the UK
Cambridge Development Corporation: Pilot a new government financing model for land, housing and infrastructure development from April 2027 (capital grant element)
Strategic Authorities: Increase funding to build capacity to deliver new powers and investment responsibilities
Founders' Relief: Introduce a new CGT relief for qualifying founders of high-growth, innovative companies from 6 April 2027
R&D Tax Reliefs: Remove the Claim Notification Form from 1 April 2027 and simplify the Additional Information Form from Autumn 2027
Enterprise Management Incentives 2 (EMI2): Increase the individual option limit to £120,000, extending the exercise period to 15 years and remove interaction with EMI option limit from 6 April 2027

Backing Innovation: Bring forward £1bn investment and increase financial capacity by £2bn for the British Business Bank to support additional investment in the UK (resource impacts of increased lending)
National Wealth Fund: Invest additional capital to support growth, including £2bn for the new Energy Wealth Fund (resource impacts of increased lending)
Artificial Intelligence: Strengthen the UK’s AI security, accelerate adoption across the economy, and support strategically important UK AI capabilities
EV Charging: Reduce the cost of using local, lower-powered public chargers in Great Britain
Rough Sleeping: Invest in a route off the streets across the Parliament, alongside longer-term accommodation and intensive support
Rough Sleeping: Reprioritise existing MHCLG budgets to tackle rough sleeping
Social and Affordable Homes Programme: Fund delivery of around 10,000 social and affordable homes
Social Housing: Introduce a zero rate of VAT for land sold to registered social housing providers (relevant housing associations) from 1 April 2027
Your First Home: Introduce a new equity loan scheme to support around 70,000 first-time buyers from April 2027 (net income from developer fees)
First Time Buyer ISA: Introduce a new ISA for first-time buyers, replacing the Lifetime ISA for new savers from 6 April 2029
Lifetime ISA: Reduce the withdrawal charge from 25% to 20% for first-time buyers purchasing properties above the £450,000 price cap from 29 October 2026
Defence Investment Plan (DIP): Commitment to further savings made at announcement on 30 June 2026
Defence Investment Plan: Reallocate capital spending to fully fund the Defence Investment Plan
Defence: Reinvest defence and security administration savings into frontline defence and national security
Ukraine: Emergency winter support for air defence
UK Export Finance: Increase capacity to support UK defence exports from June 2026 (increased income from additional activity)
HMRC: Measures to close the tax gap4
Online Marketplace Liability: Extend to UK businesses with a minimum annual sales threshold per platform of £90,000 from 1 October 2027
DWP Fraud and Error: Expand use of data and targeted controls to prevent fraud from entering the benefits system4
Welfare Reform: Remove benefit entitlements from serious offenders hospitalised in Great Britain from 6 April 2027
Distributions: Modernise the distributions framework from 6 April 2028
Advance Corporation Tax (ACT): Abolish Advance Corporation Tax from 1 April 2031
Cross-Border Services: Restrict the reverse charge on supplies of services from overseas to VAT-registered businesses from 1 April 2027
Pension Tax Allowance: Remove the income tax liability for pensioners with total income up to the value of the new State Pension from 6 April 2027 until 5 April 2030
Pensions Tax: Remove the two-year rule for taxation of pension and lump sum death benefits from 28 October 2026
Modernising Taxation of Foreign Sovereign Investments: Introduce a new statutory regime for the direct taxation of foreign sovereigns from 1 January 2029
Bank Surcharge: Temporarily increase the Bank Corporation Tax Surcharge rate from 3% to 6%, to fund breathing space measures for households, for 15 months from 1 January 2027
Machine Games Duty: Increase the rate from 20% to 25% for higher stake machines from 1 April 2027 and move duty liability to the machine supplier from 1 April 2028
Business Rates: Remove reliefs for vape shops and Adult Gaming Centres from 1 April 2027
Writing-down Allowances: Reduce the main rate writing-down allowance to 12% from April 2027 and increase the main rate first-year allowance to 50% from 1 January 2027
Private Hire Vehicle Operators: Deem larger operators with annual fare turnover over £50 million liable for VAT on the full value of their fares from 2 January 2028
Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR): Reduce the lifetime limit to £500,000 from 6 April 2027
Property Income: Increase tax rates on property income by 2ppts at the basic, higher and additional rate from 6 April 2027
Savings Income: Increase tax rates on savings income by 2ppts at the basic, higher and additional rate from 6 April 2027
Future Civil Service: Reduce administration budgets by 20% by 2029-30 compared to 16% reduction in Spending Review 2025 plans
Future Civil Service: Reinvest part of the administration budget savings in a new AI Fund to reduce administration burdens and improve outcomes
Heavy Goods Vehicles: Reduce Vehicle Excise Duty to £1 for 12 months from 1 July 2026
Great British Summer Savings Scheme: Reduce VAT to 5% on family days out from 25 June 2026 to 1 September 2026
Bus Travel: Fund free bus travel for children aged 5-15 in England from 1 August 2026 until 31 August 2026

Corporation Tax: Make the foreign permanent establishment exemption mandatory, preventing their losses from reducing UK corporation tax receipts for accounting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027
Electricity Generator Levy: Increase the rate from 45% to 55% until 31 March 2028
Industrial Electricity: Fund the British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme starting from 1 April 2027, including a backdated payment for eligible businesses
Carbon Price Support (CPS): Remove the CPS rates to reduce energy bills from 1 April 2028
Spring 2026 Youth Employment and Skills Package: Expand Youth Guarantee and apprenticeship support
Skills: Re-establish the Union Learning Fund in England
Investment for Growth: Support strategic technologies, local growth and key industries
British Business Bank: Expand the Growth Guarantee Scheme to support £6.5 billion of additional SME lending across this Parliament
Leeds City Fund: Establish the Leeds City Fund with 100% retention of business rates growth
UK-India: Bring into force the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement and Double Contributions Convention from 15 July 2026
Steel Tariff: Change tariff rate and quotas on imported steel from 1 July 2026
Stamp Taxes on Shares: Replace Stamp Duty and Stamp Duty Reserve Tax with the Securities Transfer Tax from late 2027
Business Rates: Introduce 100% relief for eligible Electric Vehicle Charging Points (EVCPs) and electric vehicle-only forecourts for ten years from 1 April 2026
Tackling Misogyny: Invest in grassroots misogyny prevention programmes
Infected Blood Compensation Scheme: Implement the Inquiry's Additional Report recommendations from 24 July 2026
Student Loans: Cap interest rates for Plan 2 and Plan 3 student loans at 6% from 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027

Waste Crime: Fund Landfill Tax costs for six priority illegal waste site clearances until 31 March 2029 and a three-year pilot to fund Local Authorities' Landfill Tax liabilities arising from illegal waste site clearances from 2027
Further Priorities: Fund key priorities, including pressures facing the NHS and delivery of the Violence against Women and Girls Strategy
Company Car Tax: Set the Benefit-in-Kind rates (appropriate percentages) for electric vehicles, hybrids and internal combustion engine vehicles for 2030-31
Supported Housing: Introduce a licensing regime to enforce national standards for supported housing from 2027-28
Donated Medicines: Introduce a zero rate of VAT for the donation of medicines under qualifying circumstances from 23 June 2026
Temporary Staffing: Amend Group 7 of Schedule 9 to the VAT Act 1994 to restore the tax treatment of medical deputies to its previously intended position
Landfill Communities Fund: Increase the Landfill Tax credit cap from 1 April 2027
Higher Education: Introduce registration requirements for franchise providers with 300 or more students from 1 September 2028, to strengthen quality and oversight of franchised provision
Local Authority Spending: Impact of adjustments to high needs budget on local authority spending
High Value Council Tax Surcharge: Confirm eligibility for deferrals, discounts and exemptions from 1 April 2028
Benefits in Kind (BiKs): Delay mandatory payrolling of company cars, vans, fuel and medical benefits from 6 April 2026 to 6 April 2027, with remaining BiKs implemented from 6 April 2028
Low Value Imports: Remove the £135 customs duty relief and introduce new customs arrangements from October 2028
Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS): Delay the inclusion of energy from waste in the ETS
Corporation Tax: Spread the one-off impact of revenue recognition changes for qualifying gas distribution activities over five years for accounting periods ending on or after 31 December 2026
International Investors: Relieve double taxation for UK investors in US Limited Liability Companies and similar entities from early 2028
